**STOP** — do NOT post security issues here in public.

Email the maintainer at **sonxpiaz@gmail.com** with:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Severity assessment (low / medium / high / critical)
- Suggested fix, if any

We'll respond within 72 hours and coordinate disclosure responsibly.
